player.name: The Hero
player.classDescription:
[class_tempest]A flurry of energy, striking before its prey can react.[/class_tempest]
If you have more Speed than an enemy, gain +0.25% Crit Chance and +1% Crit Damage per 0.01 Speed you have more than them.
If you have less Speed than an enemy, gain +0.25 Damage and +1% Increased Damage per 0.01 Speed you have less than them.
When an enemy with less Speed than you attacks you, gain 1 Static. When an enemy with more Speed than you attacks you, gain 1 Flow.
Static: +2 Damage Reduction, -0.02 Speed. Max 10 Static stacks. Flow: +5% Increased Damage, +0.01 Speed. Max 10 Flow stacks.
If you have 10 or more combined Static and Flow stacks, your next attack Discharges: 100% Increased Lightning Damage, +5% Lifesteal, and evenly consumes a total of 10 Static and Flow stacks.
At the end of combat, heal 1% Max HP for every critical hit you dealt, to a maximum heal of 30%. Abilities that damage multiple enemies will factor speed based off the first enemy only.
Starting Stats: 40 HP | 5 Damage | 8% Crit Chance | 140% Crit Damage | Lightning Damage | 1 Speed.

resourcesNeeded.description:
Enemies will begin to drop [resource]Supplies[/resource].
A new option will be unlocked: [red]Rest[/red]. [resource]Supplies[/resource] are used to [red]Rest[/red] in order to recover health.
At the end of combat, heal for 6% of your Max HP.

Enemies will begin to drop [resource]Fuel[/resource] and [resource]Blueprints[/resource].
[resource]Fuel[/resource] is used to repair equipment. [resource]Blueprints[/resource] are used to craft new peices of equipment.
You are able to craft Common and Uncommon equipment.

Enemies will begin to drop [resource]Trade Vouchers[/resource].
[resource]Trade Vouchers[/resource] are used to restock the Market's inventory.
The market can stock Common and Uncommon equipment.

Unlock the option to [gold1 bold]Ascend[/gold1 bold] at level 20.
You will be given multiple choices of [gold1]Ascendancies[/gold1] to pick from, and are allowed to switch at any point with a [resource]resource cost[/resource].

player.name: The Hero
player.classDescription:
[class_wretch]An outcast mage, revelling in the torture of flesh and blood.[/class_wretch]
You have no Stamina. All abilities cost Health to use. Gain +1% Lifesteal per 5% Missing Health.
Upon attacking an enemy with an ability, apply 1 stack of Blood Spike, up to 10 stacks.
Each stack of Blood Spike increases the execution threshold on an enemy by 2%. If an enemy's health drops below the execution threshold, they are immediately killed.
When an enemy is executed by Blood Spike, heal for 1% Max HP per stack of Blood Spike on the executed enemy.
Whilst below 40% Health: Gain +0.3 Speed, 10% Increased Dark Damage.
Starting Stats: 65 HP | 4 [damage]Damage[/damage] | 5% Crit Chance | 150% Crit Damage | [dark]Dark Damage[/dark] | 0.95 [speed]Speed[/speed].

resourcesNeeded.description:
A new option will be unlocked: [green]Brew Potions[/green]. Use supplies to brew potions to use during combat.
At the end of combat, heal for 12% of your Max HP.

[resource]Fuel[/resource] is used to repair equipment. [resource]Blueprints[/resource] are used to craft new peices of equipment.
You are able to craft Common and Uncommon equipment.

Enemies will begin to drop [resource]Trade Vouchers[/resource].
[resource]Trade Vouchers[/resource] are used to restock the Market's inventory.
The market can stock Common and Uncommon equipment.

You will be given multiple choices of [gold1]Ascendancies[/gold1] to pick from, and are allowed to switch at any point with a [resource]resource cost[/resource].

player.name: Cult
player.classDescription:
[class_cultist]A manic worshipper of demonic powers.[/class_cultist]
[resource]Insanity[/resource]: At the start of combat, [resource]Insanity[/resource] is randomly set between your minimum and maximum. Base minimum = -50, Base maximum = 50
Positive [resource]Insanity[/resource] ([resource]Manic[/resource]): +2% Increased [chaos]Chaos[/chaos] Damage per [resource]Insanity[/resource], -0.02 [speed]Speed[/speed] per [resource]Insanity[/resource], +1% [critical]Crit Chance[/critical] per 2 [resource]Insanity[/resource].
Negative [resource]Insanity[/resource] ([resource]Stable[/resource]): +1% [resistance]Damage Reduction[/resistance] per 5 [resource]Insanity[/resource], +1% Max HP gained as [buff]Shield[/buff] at turn start per 10 [resource]Insanity[/resource].
0 [resource]Insanity[/resource]: +50% Increased Damage, +25% [resistance]Damage Reduction[/resistance]. When attacking or attacked, [resource]Insanity[/resource] is randomly set between your minimum and maximum.
At maximum [resource]Insanity[/resource]: 75% Increased Damage, take 10% of damage dealt as [chaos]Chaos[/chaos] damage. [resource]Insanity[/resource] is randomly set between -1 and your minimum.
At minimum [resource]Insanity[/resource]: 25% of damage taken from next hit is gained as damage. Take no damage from the next hit. [resource]Insanity[/resource] is randomly set between 1 and your maximum.
At the start of every turn, [resource]Insanity[/resource] is randomly: Halved, Doubled, Inverted, or shifted by ±10.
Starting Stats: 35 [health]Health[/health] | 7 [damage]Damage[/damage] | 5% [critical]Crit Chance[/critical] | 160% [critical]Crit Damage[/critical] | [chaos]Chaos Damage[/chaos] | 0.9 [speed]Speed[/speed].
player.ascendancyDescription:
Minimum Insanity is increased by 10. Maximum Insanity is increased by 10. Chaos damage has a 20% chance to apply Corruption, to a maximum of 10.
Corruption: +2% Chaos Damage Taken, -1% Damage dealt. When an enemy with 5+ Corruption dies, it deals 10% of its Max HP as [chaos]chaos[/chaos] damage to all enemies.
Enemies have a 10% chance per Corruption to apply 1 Corruption to another enemy at the start of their turn.
At positive Insanity: +1% Corruption chance per 5 Insanity. At negative Insanity: Enemies lose 1 Corruption when attacking you.
At maximum Insanity, your next attack applies 2 stacks of Curse to all enemies.
At minimum Insanity, the absorbed damage is regained as health as well as being applied as damage.
-10 HP. +6 [damage]Damage[/damage]. +0.05 [speed]Speed[/speed]. +10% Dark Resistance. +15% Ailment Avoidance.

resourcesNeeded.description: The market stocks an additional 2 pieces of Equipment. The market can stock Epic equipment. The market no longer stocks Common equipment.

player.name: cgd
player.classDescription:
[class_paladin]A holy warrior blessed with divine favour.[/class_paladin]
[resource]Favour[/resource]: Gain 5-10 [resource]Favour[/resource] per turn. Max 100 [resource]Favour[/resource]. Gain +1 Max [resource]Favour[/resource] on level up. At the start of your turn, you can decide whether [resource]Favour[/resource] will be randomly spent this turn or not.
Possible attack buffs per [resource]Favour[/resource] spent: +2 Damage, +2% Increased Damage, +1% [critical]Crit Chance[/critical], +3% [critical]Crit Damage[/critical].
Possible defense buffs per [resource]Favour[/resource] spent: -2 Damage Taken, +0.1% [resistance]Damage Reduction[/resistance], 1% Max HP gained as [buff]Shield[/buff].
+5% Increased Effect of [resource]Favour[/resource] buffs per level. Heal for 20% of remaining [resource]Favour[/resource] at the end of battle.
Starting Stats: 55 [health]Health[/health] | 4 [damage]Damage[/damage] | 5% [critical]Crit Chance[/critical] | 175% [critical]Crit Damage[/critical] | [holy]Holy Damage[/holy] | 1.05 [speed]Speed[/speed].
